prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: player character design proposal sheet for the existing game NO RETURNS, a first-person four-person cooperative space-delivery game in a worn industrial depot.
Input image: the attached existing employee sheet is a visual design reference only, not an approved finished asset. Evolve its off-white workwear, burnt-orange identification panels, charcoal gloves and boots, and squat angular closed helmet with broad black visor. Create a NEW cleaner-to-read production concept sheet with substantially more believable age and use, while retaining the simple silhouette and flat back.

Composition: one wide landscape sheet, exactly THREE large full-body views of the SAME character, labeled only FRONT, SIDE, BACK in small unobtrusive English type. Front on the left in a perfectly symmetrical T-pose, both arms horizontal and fully in frame, fingers relaxed and separated enough to understand the gloved hand, legs slightly apart. In the center a true side profile with arms relaxed downward specifically to reveal the torso thickness and helmet profile. On the right a true rear view in the same symmetrical T-pose as the front. All three figures share exactly the same height, proportions, garment construction, boots and helmet. Leave generous spacing between figures so hands never overlap. Entire heads, fingers and feet visible. Simple solid warm light-gray background, even neutral studio lighting, minimal soft contact shadows. Small four-color swatches along the bottom for burnt orange, muted teal, mustard yellow and dusty violet; no extra characters, poses or props.

Subject/design: an ordinary slightly stocky industrial courier, approachable but anonymous and exhausted-looking through posture/materials, practical humanoid anatomy suitable for animation. An opaque black rectangular visor with rounded bevelled corners, no visible face or facial expression. Boxy but compact helmet, small mechanical ear inserts, no antenna. Dirty ivory heavy work coverall, faded burnt-orange shoulder/chest yoke and a restrained orange helmet identification panel, flat dark shoulder straps, low-profile utility belt, reinforced elbows and knees, thick dark work gloves with readable thumbs and fingers, broad scuffed boots. Keep shoulders, elbows and knees clearly articulated and hands clear of the body. A small plain triangular stencil on chest and back is allowed; no other logos, lettering or numbers. Back is cloth with a flat stencil only, absolutely no backpack, backplate, tank or wooden board.

Style/medium: convincing PSX-era low-poly game-character concept render with clearly simplified faceted geometry, large readable color masses, deliberately low-resolution hand-painted diffuse texture appearance and subtle pixel dither. The suit must look used for many shifts: ingrained gray dust, greasy seam wear, faded orange cloth, abrasion on cuffs/knees, chipped helmet paint and scuffed boot edges. Localized wear that preserves readable forms, not random camouflage patches. Not a glossy modern AAA astronaut, not photorealistic, not a toy, not a military armored soldier, not a smooth clean sci-fi superhero. Match the grimy old depot art direction without making the character too dark to read.

Constraints: no cargo, no baton, no weapon, no tools held in hands, no scenery, no action illustration, no facial features, no extra limbs, no disconnected hands, no overlapping views, no perspective front/back views. This is a design-review concept image, not a claim of a finished model or validated turnaround.
